title: Discovery of hydrazone derivatives as novel STAT3 antagonists against pancreatic and colorectal cancers.
authors: Yang, Hsin-Yu; Chiu, Min-Hua; Shih, Po-Chang
one_liner_zh: 该文发现靶向STAT3 SH2域的小分子抑制剂P42，虽涉及STAT3-DNA结合域但核心是药物化学与抗癌活性，无AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接辅助，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关系较弱。
abstract: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) has been an anti-cancer protein target for three decades due to its over-activation in various cancers; however, direct STAT3 inhibitors have not reached the market. In this study, a series of novel hydrazone derivatives were designed, synthesized, and characterized. The most promising compound P42 was found to selectively target the STAT3 SH2 domain over the DNA-binding domain, as suggested by the results from fluorescence polarization assays. The GI(50) values after 72 h of P42 treatment were determined to be 0.85-5 muM in STAT3-overexpressing pancreatic and colorectal cancer cell lines harboring KRAS mutations (MIA PaCa-2, DLD-1 and HCT 116). Western blot analyses showed that P42 significantly inhibited phosphorylated STAT3 levels without affecting total STAT3 and its upstream kinases JAK2 and SRC. P42 demonstrated significant autophagy-associated cell death rather than apoptosis or necrosis in flow cytometry analyses, with increases in LC3II/I ratios and decreases in p62 levels. Cancer stemness potential was significantly abrogated with P42 as shown in colony formation assay and decreases in epithelial-mesenchymal transition/stemness markers SNAIL and ZEB1 levels. Molecular docking further supported a plausible binding mode within the STAT3 SH2 domain for P42, and SwissADME prediction suggested its favorable drug-likeness properties. Taken together, P42 warrants future anti-cancer drug development.
abstract_zh: 信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）三十年来一直是抗癌蛋白靶点，因其在多种癌症中过度激活；然而，直接靶向STAT3的抑制剂尚未上市。在本研究中，设计、合成并表征了一系列新型腙衍生物。通过荧光偏振实验结果表明，最具潜力的化合物P42选择性靶向STAT3 SH2结构域，而非DNA结合结构域。在过表达STAT3且携带KRAS突变的胰腺癌和结直肠癌细胞系（MIA PaCa-2、DLD-1和HCT 116）中，P42处理72小时后的GI(50)值确定为0.85-5 μM。Western blot分析显示，P42显著抑制磷酸化STAT3水平，而不影响总STAT3及其上游激酶JAK2和SRC。流式细胞术分析表明，P42诱导显著的细胞自噬相关死亡，而非凋亡或坏死，表现为LC3II/I比值升高和p62水平降低。集落形成实验及上皮-间质转化/干性标志物SNAIL和ZEB1水平下降显示，P42显著削弱了癌症干性潜能。分子对接进一步支持P42在STAT3 SH2结构域内可能的结合模式，SwissADME预测表明其具有良好的类药性。综上，P42值得进一步开展抗癌药物开发。
